answer: Pay agents in copper credits that cannot move between accounts and can only be redeemed for compute the earning identity itself uses, capped at its own real workload. A sybil farm spreads earnings across hundreds of vertex accounts it cannot pool or sell, and each shard can burn only as much as it genuinely runs, while unused credit decays in a tightening spiral, halving each epoch. Fake identities yield balances nobody can actually spend.
